text: {"assertions":["A partial upload bug in storage/blob/uploader.rs occurred only for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary.","The bug manifested as a final part that never gets acknowledged.","The root cause was missing Unicode normalisation before hashing.","The fix applied NFC normalisation before the digest computation.","The fix was implemented in PR #2159 on the branch fix/partial-upload-1.","The bug was causing 78 duplicate rows to be written per day.","The bug can be reproduced by uploading a 40 MB fixture over a throttled link."]}
